name: Guelph / Toronto
description: The Georgetown/Kitchener corridor’s Union bus family combines multiple local/express lengths, with coverage changing as trains expanded.

timeline.event: Route 31 trip series link Union, Brampton, Georgetown, Acton, Rockwood and Guelph in several patterns.
The Kitchener booklet separates 30/31/33/39 and documents many 31 variants.
Midday 31 train-bus service was removed as Kitchener midday trains expanded.
Weekend 31 service was replaced by trains and local bus connections on other routes.

sources.title: GO Georgetown table 31, routes 31 / 33, pages dated 28 April and 1 September 2007 (archive family later renamed Kitchener)
GO Kitchener table 31, effective 6 April 2013, routes 30 / 31 / 33 / 39
Metrolinx GO Transit Ridership Report, September 2016 (original report, archived by Steve Munro)
GO Transit: April service changes, published 14 April 2023

gaps: Number 31’s initial adoption date is unknown.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
